description: This line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny,” illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) across training epochs for five different model configurations. The x-axis represents the “epoch,” ranging from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, with tick marks labeled at integer intervals. The y-axis represents “WER,” ranging from 30 to 70 on a linear scale, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 10. The plot contains five distinct lines, each corresponding to a different fine-tuning method: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (solid gray line with circle markers), “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed gray line with circle markers), “tiny int4” (solid gray line with square markers), “tiny int8” (dashed gray line with square markers), and “tiny full” (dotted gray line with triangle markers). The “tiny full” line starts at a WER of approximately 30 at epoch 0 and remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 40 at epoch 6. The “tiny int4” line begins at a WER of approximately 60 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 50 at epoch 6. The “tiny int8” line starts at approximately 60 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 50 at epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” line begins at approximately 70 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 50 at epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” line starts at approximately 60 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 50 at epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend in WER as training progresses, with the “tiny full” method consistently achieving the lowest WER throughout the training epochs.
